verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is self-hosted and can run entirely offline or air-gapped, so data stays on infrastructure the user controls. Users can also manually add, edit or delete stored memories under Settings > Personalization > Memory. The evidence does not cover deleting chats or files, configurable retention periods, or automatic purge policies. Missing for 10: chat/conversation deletion and export controls, configurable retention windows or auto-deletion, admin-level data purge documentation, independent corroboration.
